subset.input: Strict UTF-8; token offsets are Unicode character half-open intervals. A URL token covers the entire value including quotes when present.
subset.recognition: Outside comments and ordinary strings, recognize case-insensitive CSS-decoded url identifiers followed by optional whitespace and '('; recognize case-insensitive @import followed by a string or url function and a terminating semicolon. An import-url produces one import token.
subset.escapes: CSS backslash escapes: 1-6 hex digits with optional single whitespace terminator, or one non-hex non-newline character. Quoted strings may use backslash-newline continuation. Reject NUL, surrogate, out-of-range or zero escaped code points and dangling backslashes.
subset.url_values: Quoted values allow escaped characters, reject unescaped newlines. Unquoted values allow escaped characters, reject quotes, unescaped whitespace inside a value, controls and unescaped parentheses. Optional whitespace is allowed before and after the single value. Empty URL values are invalid.
subset.imports: Only @import string; and @import url(value); are supported, with whitespace/comments between import and its value and before ';'. Reject media conditions, layer and supports. Imports in this subset occur at top level before ordinary rules.
subset.opaque_content: Ordinary declarations and selectors are opaque except for recognized url calls. Comments and non-import strings never produce URL tokens. Reject unterminated comment, string, import or recognized url call. No @font-face, script, CSS expressions or nested at-rules.
subset.separation: These are lexical facts only. They contain no URL base, request identity, dependency closure or offline replacement.
